title: DisasterReady India - Home
prompt:
Build the DisasterReady India citizen home page (Nadipur District).
- Official Alert at top: Orange flood warning 'Move to higher ground now. Rani river is above the danger level at Kharadi. Water is rising.' (Updated 4 min ago, Source: CWC & DDMA). Primary button 'Get to safety'.
- 4 Primary Action Rows: 'Get to safety' (find safe evacuation route avoiding flooded underpasses), 'Ask for supplies' (request rations, water, medicine without account), 'Check my request' (track delivery status by phone/DR-number), 'Call for help' (emergency helplines).
- Utility links: 'I am helping another person', 'Listen' (voice readout), 'Make text larger', 'Low-data mode', 'Prepare for a disaster'.
- Sample data indicator & emergency footer helplines (112, 108 ambulance, 1078 NDMA).
- Clean public transit signage layout with high-contrast accessibility tokens, strict zero-distraction utilitarian aesthetic.
